title: Migration can be staged around an operating unit
text: The guide proposes moving one department at a time and stabilising its daily work before proceeding. That is an example of a bounded migration unit and adoption checkpoint. It suggests asking what must remain interoperable while old and new workflows coexist.
qualification: A proposed delivery pattern, not comparative evidence that departmental sequencing is always best; value-stream sequencing may be more appropriate.
